description: Enables the Media Library tab in TmNotionEditor's upload dialog. When supplied, users can browse previously uploaded files and insert them without re-uploading. The tab is hidden when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Returns media items matching the search query, optionally filtered by media type, with pagination support.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search query. Empty string returns all items.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Pagination offset (number of items to skip).

examples.title: In-memory implementation with seeded data
